title: Tarawera Ultra-Trail by UTMB — Mandatory Gear
claims: All athletes, including pacers, must carry mandatory gear during the race.

The TMiler mandatory list is: long sleeve thermal top, waterproof and breathable jacket, beanie/balaclava/head sock, long leg thermal pants, full-fingered lightweight thermal gloves, headlamp, spare batteries or a second headlamp or a portable USB charger, mobile phone, water bottle/collapsible cup/hydration vest, emergency survival bag (not a survival blanket), high visibility safety vest, self-adhesive bandage, and a lightweight dry sack or zip-lock bags.
TMiler athletes are required to carry the full list at all times; for T102, T50 and T21 the weather-dependent items are confirmed at 12 noon on Wednesday 10 February.
The event is cupless and athletes are strongly advised to carry their own drinking cup, bottle or hydration vest.
No mandatory gear means no start; if a mandatory item is missing during the race, the athlete cannot continue until it is replaced and a time penalty may be applied.
The high visibility safety vest must comply with AS/NZS 4602:1999, 2010 or 2011 Class D/N and must be worn when running on Tarawera Road between the Blue/Green Lake Carpark and Buried Village.

The emergency survival bag must be a bag rather than a blanket, large enough to climb into and pull tight around the shoulders; the self-adhesive bandage must be at least 40 mm wide and 2 m long unstretched.

The waterproof jacket must have fully taped (not critically taped) waterproof seams and a hood; the mobile phone must be in working order with a charged battery and a working SIM card usable in New Zealand.
Gear checks can be done early at gear check stores in New Zealand or Australia until 11 February, or at Athlete Check-In immediately before collecting the race pack.
